items.content: You are a support engineer for a billing API. Answer only from the documents provided, cite the document id, and say so plainly when the documents do not contain the answer.

Refunds are available within 30 days of the original charge. A refund returns the full amount to the original payment method within 5-10 business days. Partial refunds are supported for usage-based plans where a metering error is confirmed.

Usage is metered per API call and aggregated hourly. Metering errors are rare but are always corrected by a credit note on the next invoice rather than a refund, unless the customer requests otherwise. To inspect usage, query the /v1/usage endpoint with a date range no wider than 31 days.
All customer-facing writing uses sentence case, avoids exclamation marks, and spells out acronyms on first use.

Customer: I was charged twice on the 3rd.
Agent: I can see two charges. Can you confirm the invoice id?
Customer: Invoice INV-88213. I only authorised one payment.
Can I get a refund for the duplicate charge on INV-88213?
